AboutPage.heroSubtitle: Free spiritist literature, accessible and close to you, in Boa Vista. Browse the collection, pick your books, and come pick them up in person.
AboutPage.aboutTitle: A library in service of the Spiritist doctrine
AboutPage.aboutText:
The Francisco Cândido Xavier Library is maintained by FEAL - Spiritist Fraternity Love and Light, with the purpose of making Spiritist study accessible to everyone, free of charge.

Here you'll find works by Allan Kardec, Chico Xavier, Emmanuel, and many other authors and spirits who dedicated their work to spreading the Spiritist Doctrine - gathered in a catalog that's simple to search, so anyone can find the right book at the right time.
AboutPage.loanSubtitle: The whole collection can be browsed here on the site - the loan itself happens in person, at the library.
AboutPage.loanStep1Description: Quick sign-up with your ID number - it's free and takes less than a minute.
AboutPage.loanStep2Description: Search by title, author, theme, or category and see right away if the book is available.
AboutPage.loanStep3Description: Come to our location during one of our opening hours and pick up the book you chose.
AboutPage.loanStep4Description: Keep the book for up to 15 days, completely free, and return it on your next visit.
AboutPage.donateText: Your donation helps expand the collection and bring Spiritist reading to more people. You can drop off books in person during any of our opening hours, or arrange a drop-off by talking to us on WhatsApp.
AboutPage.donateWhatItem2: Works by Allan Kardec, Chico Xavier, and other authors and spirits of Spiritist literature
AboutPage.donateWhatItem3: Duplicate copies are also welcome - they help replace worn-out volumes

TermsOfUsePage.title: Terms of Use
TermsOfUsePage.intro: These Terms of Use govern access to and use of the site and collection of the Francisco Cândido Xavier Library, maintained by FEAL - Spiritist Fraternity Love and Light, located at Av. Princesa Isabel, 1570, Jardim Floresta, Boa Vista - RR, Brazil. By creating an account or using this site, you agree to the terms below.
TermsOfUsePage.section1Text1: This site lets you browse the library's collection (books, authors, categories, and themes) and request the loan of physical copies, free of charge. The loan itself - picking up and returning the book - happens in person, at FEAL's location, during the opening hours published in the site's footer.
TermsOfUsePage.section1Text2: Using the site and borrowing books are entirely free. No charge is made at any stage of the process.
TermsOfUsePage.section2Text1: Registration uses your ID number (CPF, in Brazil) as login, since it's a unique, personal document. You are responsible for keeping your registration data (name, email, phone) accurate and up to date, and for keeping your password confidential - all activity carried out with your account is your responsibility.
TermsOfUsePage.section2Text2: Minors should use the service under the supervision of a legal guardian.
TermsOfUsePage.section3Text1: By borrowing a book, you agree to:
section3List: Return the copy within 15 calendar days, in the same condition you received it;
Pick up and return the book in person, during one of the library's opening hours;
Notify FEAL in case of loss, damage, or delay in returning it.
TermsOfUsePage.section4Text1: By using this site, you agree not to:
section4List: Provide false information during registration or impersonate another person;
Attempt to access administrative areas or other users' data without authorization;
Use the collection or the data made available for commercial purposes without FEAL's authorization;
Engage in any act that harms the operation of the site or other users.
TermsOfUsePage.section5Text1: FEAL may suspend or terminate the access of a user who violates these terms, who accumulates unresolved overdue loans, or who misuses the service, without prejudice to other applicable measures.
TermsOfUsePage.section6Text1: The catalog, descriptive texts, and visual identity of this site belong to FEAL or its respective authors. Works in the collection retain the copyright of their original authors and publishers; borrowing only grants the right to personal, temporary use of the physical copy, without authorization for reproduction, distribution, or commercial use.
TermsOfUsePage.section7Text1: These terms may be updated periodically to reflect changes in the service or in applicable law. The date of the last update is always shown at the top of this page. Continued use of the site after a change implies agreement with the new terms.
TermsOfUsePage.section8Text1: These terms are governed by Brazilian law, including the Civil Code and the Brazilian Internet Civil Framework (Law No. 12,965/2014), with jurisdiction in the district of Boa Vista - RR, Brazil. Questions about these terms can be sent through the contact channels listed in the site's footer.

PrivacyPolicyPage.title: Privacy Policy
PrivacyPolicyPage.intro: This Privacy Policy explains how FEAL - Spiritist Fraternity Love and Light collects, uses, and protects the personal data of those who use the site and services of the Francisco Cândido Xavier Library, in compliance with Brazil's General Data Protection Law (Law No. 13,709/2018 - LGPD).
PrivacyPolicyPage.section1Text1: We collect the following data, always provided by you at registration or generated through normal use of the service:
section1List: Identification data: name, ID number (CPF), email, and phone;
Optional data: sex (used only for internal statistical purposes, if you choose to provide it);
Loan history: books borrowed, pickup and return dates;
Technical access data: IP address, browser, and device used, collected automatically when visiting collection pages.
PrivacyPolicyPage.section2Title: 2. What we use your data for
PrivacyPolicyPage.section2Text1: We use your data exclusively to:
section2List: Create and maintain your account, and allow login;
Register and manage book loans, including reminders and follow-up on overdue returns;
Generate aggregated, anonymous usage statistics for the collection, to improve the service.
PrivacyPolicyPage.section3Text1: We process your data based on the performance of the service you requested (book loans, Art. 7, V, of the LGPD), on the consent you give by accepting these terms at registration (Art. 7, I), and, for usage statistics, on FEAL's legitimate interest in improving the library (Art. 7, IX), always proportionally and without affecting your fundamental rights.
PrivacyPolicyPage.section4Title: 4. Who we share your data with
PrivacyPolicyPage.section4Text1: We do not sell or share your personal data with third parties for commercial purposes. Your data is only accessed by FEAL volunteers and librarians directly involved in managing the collection and loans, and by service providers strictly necessary to operate the site (such as the email delivery service), always under a confidentiality obligation.
PrivacyPolicyPage.section5Title: 5. How long we keep your data
PrivacyPolicyPage.section5Text1: We keep your data while your account is active and for as long as necessary to comply with legal obligations or resolve pending matters (such as a book not yet returned). You can request the deletion of your account and your data at any time, through the contact channels in the site's footer.
PrivacyPolicyPage.section6Title: 6. Your rights as a data subject
PrivacyPolicyPage.section6Text1: In accordance with Art. 18 of the LGPD, you have the right to:
section6List: Confirm whether your data is being processed;
Access, correct, or update your data;
Request the anonymization, blocking, or deletion of unnecessary data or data processed in violation of the law;
Request the portability of your data to another service;
Withdraw your consent and request the deletion of data processed based on it.
PrivacyPolicyPage.section7Text1: We use cookies that are strictly necessary for the site to work: one to keep your login session active, and another to remember your chosen language. We do not use third-party tracking or advertising cookies.
PrivacyPolicyPage.section8Text1: This policy may be updated periodically to reflect changes in the service or in applicable law. The date of the last update is always shown at the top of this page.
PrivacyPolicyPage.section9Title: 9. How to exercise your rights or ask questions
PrivacyPolicyPage.section9Text1: To exercise any of the rights above, correct your data directly on your profile page, or ask questions about this policy, contact us through the channels listed in the site's footer (WhatsApp or FEAL's social media).
